summary: Iteration 10 testing of NEW features: resume playback positions, playback speed persistence, and course completion certificate (admin toggle + student issue/download + public verify). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (position save+GET progress, auth required, certificate_enabled persists via PUT /api/content/courses/{id}, certificate 400 when incomplete / idempotent issuance / case-insensitive public verify / 404 unknown / 400 when disabled). Frontend: verified lesson-player, speed select has 6 options (0.5-2) and persists to localStorage player_rate across reload, certificate-card renders when enabled, resume-prompt shows 'Resume from 0:42' for lesson 2 with player-resume-from + player-start-over, admin edit dialog contains course-certificate-input (checked state reflects server), CERTIFICATE pill visible on course card, /verify/:code shows verify-invalid for bad code and verify-valid (with verify-name & verify-course) for issued code (also lowercase), /verify page has verify-input + verify-submit that navigates. All targeted new features are working.

issues: React hydration warning: visual-editor wrapper injects <span> inside <option> causing 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' console error. This is instrumentation-related (x-dynamic span) but still logs an error on every render. Consider marking the option children as non-editable or using plain string option label.

action_items: (Minor) Suppress hydration warning for <option> content in LessonPlayer.jsx (visual-editor injects span wrapper around dynamic rate value).
critical_code_review_comments: backend certificate issuance correctly uses secrets for code generation (EF-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) and is idempotent via existing-cert short-circuit.
GET /api/certificates/{code} properly strips user_id from response (projection {_id:0,user_id:0}) and is case-insensitive via code.strip().upper(). Good.

PUT /api/lessons/{lesson_id}/position has no ownership/entitlement check on lesson_id - any authenticated user can save position for any lesson id (even non-existent). Low risk but could allow garbage data. Consider validating lesson exists / user has access.
LessonPlayer uses onContextMenu block; good UX for anti-copy.
